purpose: Distinguish an accidental click friction mapping from the native velocity cap using the identical left-neutral T1 fixture.
override_timing: After the unchanged 1 s T1 settle prefix, immediately before the force scan; no position/velocity/target write. Each condition starts in a fresh scene.
velocity_override_unit: m/s for the selected prismatic joint
velocity_override_basis: Fixed diagnostic-only nonbinding cap, selected before results; uses the prototype's 1000 numerical scale only to remove limiting in this short scan. It is neither a measured speed nor an approved production value.
unchanged: All non-click parameters and the click physical return law, cap force point and direction, timestep, fixed root, gravity and SDF. No cone attached during this diagnosis.
measurements: Every step: applied world force, native positive click axis, projection, q, raw travel fraction, unchanged signal, qvel; every joint policy before/after the single override.

interpretation.friction_mapping: Confirm only if native baseline click friction is wrongly nonzero and b changes only that field and restores motion while a does not. If native friction is already zero, this hypothesis is refuted.
interpretation.velocity_contribution: Confirm a causal velocity-cap contribution if c changes only the click max_velocity and restores motion while a/b do not. Do not claim the precise internal solver mechanism or adopt the override.
interpretation.old_model: d establishes the response of the frozen main model under the same fixture; it is a requested multi-model control, not a single-parameter comparison.
interpretation.stop: If velocity semantics or another non-mapping parameter is implicated, preserve production values, write a proposal and stop before T1/T2 acceptance or cone integration. No tuning sweep.
